method: Version 7 page notes revised under the Study Studio instructions with direct explanations. Unnecessary caveats, contrastive not-statements and limits that the source does not state are replaced with affirmative teaching. Source-stated limitations stay. Page-specific authored teaching notes following the Study Studio note instructions. Each instructional page is taught in source order as bolded main bullets of connected spoken sentences with nested sub-bullets for mechanisms, experiment setup, observations and interpretation, and the values in instructional figures. No presentation narration, arrow chains, colons or semicolons, added topics, padding of titles or logistics, or references to other pages. Matching review pages reuse the lecture notes, and review page 54 is authored separately.
